flagged_days.note: Flash-loan loops, not payments. Between 05:43 and 09:53 UTC a handful of bot contracts borrowed USDT from Morpho Blue in $40M flash loans and cycled it in and out of the address Etherscan labels 'BiFi Finance: USDT Wallet' dozens of times per transaction, repaying in the same transaction. 15 address pairs, all contracts, carried 87% of the day's $100k+ volume.

checks.name: Tron zero-burn share is between 0% and 100%
Volumes and transfer counts are zero or positive
Size-band shares are each 0–100% and sum to 100%
Ordinary-wallet volume never exceeds all-transfer volume on any day
Every rail has data for every day in the window
Top-10 sender shares are between 0% and 100%
Stablecoin prices are within $0.90–$1.10 (else the price feed is broken)
Comparison has at least 5 comparable days in each window
Outlier days are flagged and left out of comparisons

compare.rule: Before/after figures compare average weekdays (Mon–Fri) only, and leave out any day flagged as an outlier, so a quiet weekend or a one-off spike can't drive the result.
